name: metriq-mobile
description: The Metriq phone app: a native shell (Capacitor) around the same Metriq everyone uses in the browser.

scripts.android: node scripts/prepare.mjs && cap sync android && cap open android
scripts.android:apk: node scripts/prepare.mjs && cap sync android && node scripts/gradle.mjs assembleDebug
scripts.ios: node scripts/prepare.mjs && cap sync ios && cap open ios
